description: Detects the address format (EVM or Solana) and checks on-chain whether it is a wallet, a smart contract or a token mint, so agents do not send funds to the wrong kind of account. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

chain.description: One of solana, ethereum, base, polygon, arbitrum

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: address_check
